purpose: This module implements stage 8 of a badminton video pipeline: it takes a whole-video shuttle-position track and turns it into rally spans (start/end frames of each rally) and contact events (frames where a player hits the shuttle). It works by finding stretches of shuttle motion separated by "rest" (slow or untracked) periods, then within each rally span detecting sudden velocity changes ("impulses") as candidate contacts, filtering those against player-wrist proximity, and de-duplicating nearby candidates. It also has an optional CLI entry point for batch-processing a directory of tracks into CSV outputs.

public_api.name: scale_thresholds
public_api.role: Rescales an fps-independent Stage8Thresholds preset to a given fps using the base-30 lookup table; called when segmenting video shot at a non-default frame rate.

public_api.name: CourtGeo
public_api.role: NamedTuple holding court geometry (x/y bounds, net band) used to filter person detections to the court; constructed by callers doing player-slot filtering.

public_api.name: ServeSetupInputs
public_api.role: NamedTuple bundling per-frame sticky-tracker evidence (ankle/wrist/height data) for the serve-setup stillness gate; built by build_serve_setup_inputs and consumed by serve_setup_still.

public_api.name: series_drift
public_api.role: Computes median-half positional drift of a sentinel-coded point series; used internally to measure how much a player moved during a lookback window.

public_api.name: serve_setup_still
public_api.role: Returns whether specified players stayed still (drift below a body-height threshold) through a claimed serve frame; used as part of the serve-start gating option.

public_api.name: build_serve_setup_inputs
public_api.role: Builds and validates a ServeSetupInputs object from a StickyResult and video resolution; call before using serve-start gating in segment_video.

public_api.name: ServeStartMode
public_api.role: StrEnum (TRIM/REJECT) controlling what happens to a rally region with no serve-setup-qualifying burst.

public_api.name: ServeStartClose
public_api.role: StrEnum (BURST/LAST_REST) controlling where a split rally span closes under serve-start gating.

public_api.name: ServeStartOptions
public_api.role: NamedTuple bundling all serve-start gating configuration passed to segment_video/find_rally_spans to require a serve-setup lookback before opening a rally span.

public_api.name: serve_setup_still
public_api.role: (listed above)

public_api.name: court_scale_slots
public_api.role: Returns which pose-detection slot indices fall within court geometry bounds, for filtering players to those actually on court.

public_api.name: apply_replay_mask
public_api.role: Freezes replay/dead-time frames of a track to the last live position so they read as rest; called at the start of segment_video when a replay_mask is supplied.

public_api.name: span_impulses
public_api.role: Computes per-junction velocity-change magnitude (impulse) within one rally span; the raw signal contact detection is built on.

public_api.name: rolling_floor
public_api.role: Computes a rolling median 'floor' of impulse values over visible junctions, used as the local baseline that a real contact's impulse must exceed by a multiple.

public_api.name: impulse_cell_candidates
public_api.role: Finds raw contact candidates in a span using the impulse-vs-floor rule plus dedup by radius; called by detect_contact_flags.

public_api.name: detect_contact_flags
public_api.role: Thin wrapper around impulse_cell_candidates returning (frame, impulse) contact candidates for one span.

public_api.name: contact_proximity_ok
public_api.role: Guardrail check: is a tracked player near the shuttle at a candidate contact frame; called per-candidate when court positions are available, annotates but never filters.

public_api.name: wrist_contact_near
public_api.role: Body-unit wrist-distance gate on one contact frame; used to filter/annotate raw impulse candidates when sticky wrist distances are supplied.

public_api.name: suppress_contact_flags
public_api.role: Greedy, impulse-ranked suppression of nearby duplicate contact flags within a frame radius; called after wrist gating to produce the final accepted contact set.

public_api.name: tracker_segments
public_api.role: Intersects homography scene-row frame ranges with a court-present boolean mask to get maximal usable tracking intervals; used to scope the sticky player-tracking loop.

public_api.name: build_sticky_result
public_api.role: Runs the sticky player-anchor tracking loop (imported from the bst_x package) over given segments to produce per-frame player position/wrist-distance evidence; called before serve-start gating or wrist-contact gating that needs sticky data.

public_api.name: find_rally_spans
public_api.role: Span-only segmentation entry point: computes rest/speed and returns rally (start,end) spans without doing contact detection; called directly or via segment_video.

public_api.name: assemble_contacts
public_api.role: Given already-chosen spans, runs contact detection, wrist gating, and suppression to produce the list of ContactCandidate rows; called by segment_video.

public_api.name: segment_video
public_api.role: Main entry point: full stage-8 pass over one video's track, combining span-finding and contact assembly with all optional gating/masking behaviour; the top-level function most external callers use.

public_api.name: main
public_api.role: CLI entry point (python -m annotator.rally_segmentation --shuttle-dir ...) that batch-processes a directory of shuttle tracks into rally-spans and contact-frames CSVs.
